note: PROVISIONAL crop made by the frontend; the data owner delivers the processed package. Heights are metres above the MOLA areoid (DeltaGeoid product).

source.title: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM mosaic
source.projection: Equirectangular, standard parallel 0, central meridian 0, Mars 2000 sphere IAU (R = 3396190 m)
source.licence: Not verified here: USGS-hosted NASA planetary data, see the product page for usage terms

crop.method: bilinear resampling onto a local tangent ENU grid (east = R cos(lat) dlon, north = R dlat); 4 m cells from a 20 m source, so no resolution gain (display resampling)
